name: Submit a public-service request
short_description: Identify the appropriate public service channel and submit a complete, traceable request with supporting information.
self_assessment: I can submit one traceable public-service request without help and retain its confirmation.
description: Identify the appropriate public service channel and submit a complete, traceable request with supporting information. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Submit a request about shared infrastructure
